source_model: v2 CPU checkpoint after 12058 decisions / 12057 updates on four consumed TRAIN track-1 roads
method: H=3 model-predicted reward-only return versus actual discounted raw reward for five fixed candidate action suffixes at each parity-replayed anchor; no Q bootstrap or newly selected roads
parity_scope: All actual branch suffixes started after independent full-prefix matching of road geometry, wrapped environment decision clocks, raw commands, pixels, reward, flags, and extensive accessible simulator state against a v2 checkpoint-bound TRAIN replay reconstruction. Historical v2 hidden Box2D solver state and historical road signature were not recorded and are not proven identical.
limits: Four repeatedly consumed TRAIN road geometries, 12 anchors, shared candidate actions, strongly dependent pairwise comparisons, ties within every anchor and only seven anchors with an informative pair. 0.625 is an in-development baseline descriptive statistic, not a significance test, official ranking score, driving improvement, or evidence that ranking improves with additional learning. Preserve identical anchors and candidate returns when rescoring the 20k/40k/70k/100k checkpoints; do not tune candidate suffixes on this result.
